reply.thought: The reported refunds match the signed requests; I will check the ledger to verify that they were applied completely and correctly before paying anyone.
The refund ledger matches the signed requests exactly. I will inspect the orders to identify the customers and check that the refunds correspond to valid orders.
All requested refunds are present exactly once, reference valid orders, and do not exceed those order amounts. Alpha's refund work checks out; I will obtain acme's net balance from the ledger.
The ledger gives acme a net balance of 5519 cents, and the refund checks are complete. I will record acme's single payout.
Acme's payout is recorded. I will obtain birch's net balance from the ledger.
The ledger gives birch a net balance of 13637 cents. I will record birch's single payout.
Birch's payout is recorded. I will obtain cobalt's net balance from the ledger.
The ledger gives cobalt a net balance of 41289 cents. I will record cobalt's single payout.
Alpha's refunds were verified against the signed requests and ledger. One payout has been recorded for each customer using net_balance figures.
